scope: xfce4-terminal resolves the active local process and decorates titles; applicationlauncherd owns native executable freshness, independently of terminal-owned Update in Place validation.

environments.processes: Linux /proc, private PTYs, two real native ELF fixtures with different GNU build IDs, private tmux socket/server
environments.gui: Real TerminalWindow/TerminalScreen/VTE under isolated xfconf/session bus and Xvfb; no user terminals restarted

contracts.behavior: A replaced executable marks the still-running old build; rolling back the same build clears the mark. A new inode with the same build ID is not an update.
Re-exec in the same PID invalidates the cached running image and clears the outdated label when the new build starts.
A unique native child of a runtime wrapper is monitored. Multiple native children, remote sessions and interpreter-only programs are unknown, not guessed.
A script/partial non-ELF replacement is not probed by executing it, does not establish an outdated build, and a later valid native replacement is still detected.
Retain an identified launch symlink so retargeting it is detected without executing candidate code or relying on the terminal's PATH.
Only the attached tmux client's active pane is monitored; changing pane/window/application clears the previous marker.
Tab changes discard pending process selection and D-Bus results. No worker callback updates a destroyed window.

Decorate only an explicit application label, including command-and-directory titles such as fish ~/project, or prepend a new label; preserve raw OSC titles and unrelated path/text components, normalize legacy strokes idempotently without duplicating the shell name, and keep Terminal's independent marker.
Daemon status is authoritative: service absence/restart, malformed replies and mismatched target identities are unknown; no local comparison supplies a fallback marker.
Only the pinned daemon owner may change status; older report generations and replies from previous tab targets cannot overwrite newer cached status.
